title: Mastering Python For Loops

sections.title: Why loops matter
bullets: A loop repeats an action without duplicating code.
For loops are useful when working with a sequence of items.
The loop body runs once for every item.

sections.title: Follow the iteration
bullets: Python takes the first item from the sequence.
The loop variable stores the current item.
After the body runs, Python moves to the next item.

visual.title: One pass of the loop
items: Store it in the loop variable

sections.title: Use range safely
bullets: The start value is included, but the stop value is excluded.
Indentation tells Python which statements belong to the loop.

summary: A for loop processes one sequence item at a time.
The loop variable changes on every iteration.
range includes its start and excludes its stop.
Indented statements form the loop body.
